name: sol-zcode
description: SoL token-efficiency mechanisms (action fusion, observation pack, evidence-preserving reducer, online context compact, trajectory inspector) as a ZCode plugin. All mechanisms are opt-in and default off.

description_i18n.en: SoL token-efficiency mechanisms (action fusion, observation pack, evidence-preserving reducer, online context compact, trajectory inspector) as a ZCode plugin. All mechanisms are opt-in and default off.
description_i18n.zh-CN: SoL 令牌效率机制（动作融合、观察包、证据保留型约简器、在线上下文压缩、轨迹检查器）的 ZCode 插件。所有机制默认关闭，需显式开启。

actionFusion.title: Action Fusion
actionFusion.description: Expose sol_write/sol_edit MCP tools that accept an optional then_run {command, timeout?} follow-up executed in the same call.

observationPack.title: Observation Pack
observationPack.description: Archive tool results over 10 KiB and return a compact placeholder; recall with obs_recall (paging + literal search). Also archives large native tool outputs read-only.

evidenceReducer.title: Evidence-Preserving Reducer
evidenceReducer.description: Reduce long failing diagnostic logs (build/test) to a verified evidence receipt quoting exact lines; the original stays archived for readback.

onlineCompact.title: Online Context Compact
onlineCompact.description: Track plan boundaries and context economics; suggest compaction at economical points via the Stop hook and remind after compaction.

trajectory.title: Trajectory Inspector
trajectory.description: Append-only metadata-only JSONL trajectory with hash chain (never prompts/args/outputs); query with sol_trajectory.

actionFusionGate.title: Action Fusion hard gate
actionFusionGate.description: Block native Write/Edit with exit-2 so the model must use sol_write/sol_edit. Optional ablation arm; leave off for normal use.

reducerModel.title: Reducer model
reducerModel.description: Model id (provider/model) for the reducer subprocess. Empty = inherit the host model from ~/.zcode/cli/config.json.
